name: TautWeekly-for-Plex
extra_parameters: --read-only --publish 127.0.0.1:8787:8080/tcp --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m,mode=1777 --tmpfs /run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,mode=0755 --stop-timeout 1800 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETUID
description: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli. The authenticated TautWeekly Manager recovery endpoint is fixed to Unraid loopback port 8787; use an SSH local forward for initial setup and recovery, then optional public HTTPS access only through Tailscale Funnel. After installation, retrieve the one-time pairing token from the container Console with: /opt/tautweekly/bin/run-as-user.sh /opt/tautweekly/bin/tautweekly-manager access-bootstrap --data-dir /data/manager. The pairing token is never written to logs. Unraid owns container lifecycle and stable image updates.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Private configuration, Manager credentials, state, backups, logs, assets, and generated previews. Preserve this path across updates and reinstalls.

paths.name: Tailscale state
paths.description: Root-only state for the optional official Tailscale userspace runtime. Keep separate from /data; never share, inspect, or back it up as ordinary Manager data.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

variables.name: Runtime profile
variables.description: Validated unified-image behavior profile. Keep unraid for this template.

variables.name: Public Funnel adapter
variables.description: Set to enabled only to start the isolated official Tailscale userspace runtime. Then use the container Console command /opt/tautweekly/bin/tautweekly-funnel login; auth keys and tokens are refused.

variables.name: Preview Base URL
variables.description: Leave empty for loopback recovery. The Manager supplies its independently verified Funnel URL when public access is Active.

variables.name: Manager Allowed Hosts
variables.description: Leave empty for loopback recovery. The exact active Funnel hostname is admitted automatically after backend verification; schemes, paths, ports, and wildcards are refused.

variables.name: Secure Manager Cookies
variables.description: Leave false for loopback HTTP recovery. Verified Funnel requests receive the public HTTPS cookie boundary automatically.

variables.name: Package Kind
variables.description: Identifies the Unraid-owned update path to the Manager. Keep this at the value supplied by Community Apps.

variables.name: Host Adapter API
variables.description: Package compatibility marker used to detect an older saved Unraid template. Keep this at the value supplied by the current Community Apps template.
